import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
from policy import *

arm = sys.argv[1]; px = float(sys.argv[2]); py = float(sys.argv[3]); tag = sys.argv[4]
Z_GRASP = 0.9275

obs = current()
pads_l = pads(obs)
print("pads:", [ (np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), round(p["top"],4)) for p in pads_l ])
ps = pieces(obs)
for r in ps:
    print("piece c", np.round(r["center"],4).tolist(), "axis", np.round(r["axis"],3).tolist(),
          "span", round(r["span"],4), "z", round(r["zmin"],4), round(r["zmax"],4), "n", r["n"])
p = nearest(ps, (px,py))
print("target piece", np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), "dist_mm", round(1000*float(np.linalg.norm(p["center"][:2]-[px,py])),1))
s = topdir(p); jaw = np.array([-s[1], s[0], 0.0])
# grasp point: lower-middle of the piece along its top direction (away from a flag/loop end)
t = p["t"]; q1,q2 = np.percentile(t,[20,50])
sel = (t>=q1)&(t<=q2)
if sel.sum() < 15:
    g = p["center"].copy()
else:
    g = p["pts"][sel].mean(0)
print("grasp pt", np.round(g,4).tolist(), "jaw", np.round(jaw,3).tolist())

pre = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_PRE])
dry = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="free_space")}, dry_run=True)
print("dry pre-grasp feasible", dry.feasible, dry.failure_code, str(dry.summary)[:300])
if not dry.feasible:
    handoff("pre-grasp infeasible", pos=pre.tolist(), summary=str(dry.summary))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="free_space")})
check_move(r, "pre-grasp")
print("pre-grasp", r.status, r.target_error_m)

grasp_pos = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_GRASP])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(grasp_pos), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="careful")
check_move(r, "descend")
print("descend", r.status, r.target_error_m)

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
print("close", r.status, r.ok, "opening", r.measured_opening, "commanded", r.commanded_opening)

r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "lift")
print("lift", r.status, r.target_error_m)

obs2 = current()
fp = obs2.pose(arm).position.xyz
print("flange now", np.round(fp,4).tolist())
ps2 = pieces(obs2, zlo=0.80, zhi=1.05)
for r_ in ps2:
    print("held cand c", np.round(r_["center"],4).tolist(), "axis", np.round(r_["axis"],3).tolist(),
          "z", round(r_["zmin"],4), round(r_["zmax"],4), "n", r_["n"],
          "dxy_mm", round(1000*float(np.linalg.norm(r_["center"][:2]-fp[:2])),1))

import sys, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point, pixels_to_world
from policy import *
from geom import blue_components, robust_piece

arm   = sys.argv[1]
pad_i = int(sys.argv[2])
tag   = sys.argv[3]
kind  = sys.argv[4]                  # 'digit' or 'ring'
ex, ey = float(sys.argv[5]), float(sys.argv[6])   # pre-grasp top direction (prior)
thick  = float(sys.argv[7])          # piece thickness measured on the table
TOL_XY = 0.012; TOL_ANG = 15.0; TOL_Z = 0.008
Z_TRANSFER = 0.98
cam_name = {"left":"left_wrist","right":"right_wrist"}[arm]

obs = current()
pads_l = pads(obs)
pad = pads_l[pad_i]; pad_xy = pad["center"][:2].copy(); pad_top = pad["top"]
pose = obs.pose(arm); f_now = pose.position.xyz.copy()
app_now = pose.axis("x").xyz; jaw_now = pose.axis("y").xyz; z_now = pose.axis("z").xyz
print("pad", pad_i, np.round(pad_xy,4).tolist(), "top", round(pad_top,4))
print("flange", np.round(f_now,4).tolist(), "jaw", np.round(jaw_now,3).tolist(), "localz", np.round(z_now,3).tolist())

# --- measure the held piece from the wrist camera
rgb = np.asarray(obs.camera(cam_name).rgb)
comps = blue_components(rgb, min_area=150)
best = None
for mk in comps:
    r = robust_piece(mk, camera=cam_name, zlo=0.70, zhi=1.15)
    if r is None: continue
    exp = f_now + 0.15*app_now
    d = float(np.linalg.norm(r["center"] - exp))
    r["_d"] = d
    if best is None or d < best["_d"]: best = r
if best is None:
    handoff("held piece not seen", camera=cam_name, ncomp=len(comps))
p = best
print("held piece c", np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), "z", round(p["zmin"],4), round(p["zmax"],4),
      "hole", p["hole_area"], None if p["hole_uv"] is None else np.round(p["hole_uv"],1).tolist(),
      "axis", np.round(p["axis"],3).tolist(), "n", p["n"], "dist_to_expected_mm", round(1000*p["_d"],1))

p_xy = p["center"][:2].copy()
s = None
if kind == "digit" and p["hole_area"] >= 15 and p["hole_uv"] is not None:
    hw = pixels_to_world(cam_name, [list(map(float,p["hole_uv"]))])[0]
    d = hw.xyz[:2] - p_xy
    if np.linalg.norm(d) > 0.25*p["span"]:
        s = d/np.linalg.norm(d)
        print("top dir from hole", np.round(s,3).tolist(), "hole offset_mm", round(1000*float(np.linalg.norm(d)),1))
if s is None and kind == "digit":
    s = np.array([p["axis"][0], p["axis"][1]])
    prior = np.array([ex,ey]); prior/=np.linalg.norm(prior)
    if np.dot(s, prior) < 0: s = -s
    print("top dir from pca", np.round(s,3).tolist(), "dot prior", round(float(np.dot(s,prior)),3))

theta = 0.0 if kind == "ring" else float(np.arctan2(s[0], s[1]))
print("theta_deg", round(np.degrees(theta),1))
jaw_new = rotz(jaw_now, theta); jaw_new[2]=0.0; jaw_new/=np.linalg.norm(jaw_new)
o = np.array([p_xy[0]-f_now[0], p_xy[1]-f_now[1], 0.0])
o_r = rotz(o, theta)
fl_xy = pad_xy - o_r[:2]
bottom_off = f_now[2] - (p["zmax"] - thick)
fl_z = pad_top + 0.002 + bottom_off
print("jaw_new", np.round(jaw_new,3).tolist(), "offset", np.round(o,4).tolist(), "->", np.round(o_r,4).tolist())
print("flange target xy", np.round(fl_xy,4).tolist(), "z_place", round(fl_z,4), "bottom_off", round(bottom_off,4))

# --- transfer + rotate above the pad
tgt1 = target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="free_space")
dry = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1}, dry_run=True)
print("dry transfer feasible", dry.feasible, dry.failure_code, str(dry.summary)[:260])
if not dry.feasible:
    handoff("transfer infeasible", xy=fl_xy.tolist(), summary=str(dry.summary))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1})
check_move(r, "transfer")
print("transfer", r.status, r.target_error_m)

# --- descend to the pad
tgt2 = target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], fl_z]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="precision")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt2}, speed="careful")
check_move(r, "place-descend")
print("place-descend", r.status, r.target_error_m)

r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
print("open", r.status, r.ok, "opening", r.measured_opening)

r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "release-lift")
print("release-lift", r.status, r.target_error_m)

r = tools.return_home(arms=[arm])
print("home", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code)

# --- verify from the fresh head view
obs3 = current()
ps3 = pieces(obs3)
print("pieces seen:", [ (np.round(x["center"][:2],4).tolist(), round(x["zmin"],4)) for x in ps3 ])
near = [x for x in ps3 if float(np.linalg.norm(x["center"][:2]-pad_xy)) < 0.05]
if not near:
    handoff("placed piece not found on pad", pad_xy=pad_xy.tolist(),
            seen=[np.round(x["center"][:2],3).tolist() for x in ps3])
q = near[0]
xy_err = float(np.linalg.norm(q["center"][:2]-pad_xy))
ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(q["axis"][0], q["axis"][1]))
print("placed", np.round(q["center"],4).tolist(), "xy_err_mm", round(1000*xy_err,1), "ang_from_plusY_deg", round(ang,1),
      "zmin", round(q["zmin"],4))
if xy_err > TOL_XY or abs(ang) > TOL_ANG or abs(q["zmin"]-pad_top) > TOL_Z:
    handoff("placement check failed", tag=tag, xy_err_mm=1000*xy_err, ang_deg=ang,
            zmin=q["zmin"], pad_top=pad_top, tol_xy=TOL_XY, tol_ang=TOL_ANG, tol_z=TOL_Z)
print("PLACED_OK", tag)

s = open('/work/place_step.py').read()
s = s.replace('''pads_l = pads(obs)
pad = pads_l[pad_i]; pad_xy = pad["center"][:2].copy(); pad_top = pad["top"]''',
'''import json
PAD_DB = json.load(open("/work/pads.json"))
pads_l = pads(obs)
if len(pads_l) < 4:
    print("pad detection occluded (%d), using stored measurement" % len(pads_l))
    pad_xy = np.array(PAD_DB["pads"][pad_i]); pad_top = PAD_DB["pad_top"]
else:
    pad = pads_l[pad_i]; pad_xy = pad["center"][:2].copy(); pad_top = pad["top"]''')
open('/work/place_step.py','w').write(s)
print("ok")

import sys, json, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
from policy import *
from geom import blue_components, robust_piece

arm   = sys.argv[1]; pad_i = int(sys.argv[2]); kind = sys.argv[3]; tag = sys.argv[4]
px, py = float(sys.argv[5]), float(sys.argv[6])
Z_PRE, Z_GRASP, Z_TRANSFER = 0.945, 0.9275, 0.98
DROP_M = 0.005
TOL_XY, TOL_ANG, TOL_Z = 0.014, 20.0, 0.010
DB = json.load(open("/work/pads.json")); TABLE_Z = DB["table_z"]

obs = current()
pads_l = pads(obs)
if len(pads_l) < 4:
    pad_xy = np.array(DB["pads"][pad_i]); pad_top = DB["pad_top"]; print("pads occluded -> stored")
else:
    pad_xy = pads_l[pad_i]["center"][:2].copy(); pad_top = pads_l[pad_i]["top"]
ps = pieces(obs)
for r in ps: print("  piece", np.round(r["center"],4).tolist(), "axis", np.round(r["axis"],3).tolist(),
                   "span", round(r["span"],4), "zmax", round(r["zmax"],4), "n", r["n"])
p = nearest(ps, (px,py))
if float(np.linalg.norm(p["center"][:2]-[px,py])) > 0.03:
    handoff("target piece not where expected", found=np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), want=[px,py])
s = topdir(p)                        # unit top direction, sign from end-spread asymmetry
jaw = np.array([-s[1], s[0], 0.0])   # jaw line across the numeral stroke
t = p["t"]; q1,q2 = np.percentile(t,[20,50]); sel=(t>=q1)&(t<=q2)
g = p["pts"][sel].mean(0) if sel.sum()>=15 else p["center"].copy()
thick = float(p["zmax"] - TABLE_Z)
print("target", tag, np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), "top", np.round(s,3).tolist(),
      "angle", round(np.degrees(np.arctan2(s[0],s[1])),1), "thick", round(thick,4), "grasp", np.round(g,4).tolist())

# ---------- grasp
pre = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_PRE])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="free_space")})
check_move(r, "pre-grasp")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([g[0],g[1],Z_GRASP]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="careful")
print("descend", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if (not r.ok) and (r.target_error_m or 1) > 0.004: handoff("descend failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
print("close", r.status, "opening", r.measured_opening)
if r.measured_opening is not None and r.measured_opening < 0.21:
    handoff("gripper closed empty", opening=r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "lift")
f_grasp = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_GRASP])
print("lift done", r.status)

# ---------- place using grasp-time geometry (head-camera measurement)
o_xy = p["center"][:2] - f_grasp[:2]
theta = float(np.arctan2(s[0], s[1]))
o_r = rotz(np.array([o_xy[0], o_xy[1], 0.0]), theta)
jaw_new = rotz(jaw, theta); jaw_new[2] = 0.0; jaw_new /= np.linalg.norm(jaw_new)
fl_xy = pad_xy - o_r[:2]
bottom_off = Z_GRASP - (p["zmax"] - thick)
fl_z = pad_top + DROP_M + bottom_off
print("theta", round(np.degrees(theta),1), "jaw_new", np.round(jaw_new,3).tolist(),
      "fl_xy", np.round(fl_xy,4).tolist(), "fl_z", round(fl_z,4))

tgt1 = target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="free_space")
dry = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1}, dry_run=True)
print("dry transfer", dry.feasible, dry.failure_code, str(dry.summary)[:200])
if not dry.feasible: handoff("transfer infeasible", summary=str(dry.summary))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1}); check_move(r, "transfer")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], fl_z]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="careful")
print("place-descend", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if (not r.ok) and (r.target_error_m or 1) > 0.004: handoff("place-descend failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"}); print("open", r.status, r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "release-lift")
r = tools.return_home(arms=[arm]); print("home", r.status, r.ok)

# ---------- verify from fresh head view
obs3 = current()
ps3 = pieces(obs3)
print("pieces now:", [(np.round(x["center"][:2],4).tolist(), round(x["zmin"],4)) for x in ps3])
near = [x for x in ps3 if float(np.linalg.norm(x["center"][:2]-pad_xy)) < 0.05]
if not near: handoff("placed piece not found", pad=pad_xy.tolist(),
                    seen=[np.round(x["center"][:2],3).tolist() for x in ps3])
q = near[0]
xy_err = float(np.linalg.norm(q["center"][:2]-pad_xy)); ang = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(q["axis"][0],q["axis"][1])))
print("PLACED", tag, "xy_err_mm", round(1000*xy_err,1), "ang_deg", round(ang,1), "zmin", round(q["zmin"],4), "pad_top", pad_top)
if xy_err > TOL_XY or abs(ang) > TOL_ANG or abs(q["zmin"]-pad_top) > TOL_Z:
    handoff("placement check failed", tag=tag, xy_err_mm=1000*xy_err, ang_deg=ang, zmin=q["zmin"], pad_top=pad_top)
print("OK", tag)

import sys, json, numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, handoff
from ora_lib import current, Direction, Point
from policy import *
from geom import blue_components, robust_piece

arm   = sys.argv[1]; pad_i = int(sys.argv[2]); kind = sys.argv[3]; tag = sys.argv[4]
px, py = float(sys.argv[5]), float(sys.argv[6])
Z_PRE, Z_GRASP, Z_TRANSFER = 0.945, 0.9275, 0.98
DROP_M = 0.005
TOL_XY, TOL_ANG, TOL_Z = 0.014, 20.0, 0.010
DB = json.load(open("/work/pads.json")); TABLE_Z = DB["table_z"]

obs = current()
pads_l = pads(obs)
if len(pads_l) < 4:
    pad_xy = np.array(DB["pads"][pad_i]); pad_top = DB["pad_top"]; print("pads occluded -> stored")
else:
    pad_xy = pads_l[pad_i]["center"][:2].copy(); pad_top = pads_l[pad_i]["top"]
ps = pieces(obs)
for r in ps: print("  piece", np.round(r["center"],4).tolist(), "axis", np.round(r["axis"],3).tolist(),
                   "span", round(r["span"],4), "zmax", round(r["zmax"],4), "n", r["n"])
p = nearest(ps, (px,py))
if float(np.linalg.norm(p["center"][:2]-[px,py])) > 0.03:
    handoff("target piece not where expected", found=np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), want=[px,py])
s = topdir(p)                        # unit top direction, sign from end-spread asymmetry
jaw = np.array([-s[1], s[0], 0.0])   # jaw line across the numeral stroke
t = p["t"]; q1,q2 = np.percentile(t,[20,50]); sel=(t>=q1)&(t<=q2)
g = p["pts"][sel].mean(0) if sel.sum()>=15 else p["center"].copy()
thick = float(p["zmax"] - TABLE_Z)
print("target", tag, np.round(p["center"],4).tolist(), "top", np.round(s,3).tolist(),
      "angle", round(np.degrees(np.arctan2(s[0],s[1])),1), "thick", round(thick,4), "grasp", np.round(g,4).tolist())

# ---------- grasp
pre = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_PRE])
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="free_space")})
check_move(r, "pre-grasp")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([g[0],g[1],Z_GRASP]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="careful")
print("descend", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if (not r.ok) and (r.target_error_m or 1) > 0.004: handoff("descend failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
print("close", r.status, "opening", r.measured_opening)
if r.measured_opening is not None and r.measured_opening < 0.21:
    handoff("gripper closed empty", opening=r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P(pre), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "lift")
f_grasp = np.array([g[0], g[1], Z_GRASP])
print("lift done", r.status)

# ---------- place using grasp-time geometry (head-camera measurement)
o_xy = p["center"][:2] - f_grasp[:2]
theta = float(np.arctan2(s[0], s[1]))
o_r = rotz(np.array([o_xy[0], o_xy[1], 0.0]), theta)
jaw_new = rotz(jaw, theta); jaw_new[2] = 0.0; jaw_new /= np.linalg.norm(jaw_new)
fl_xy = pad_xy - o_r[:2]
bottom_off = Z_GRASP - (p["zmax"] - thick)
fl_z = pad_top + DROP_M + bottom_off
print("theta", round(np.degrees(theta),1), "jaw_new", np.round(jaw_new,3).tolist(),
      "fl_xy", np.round(fl_xy,4).tolist(), "fl_z", round(fl_z,4))

tgt1 = target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="free_space")
dry = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1}, dry_run=True)
print("dry transfer", dry.feasible, dry.failure_code, str(dry.summary)[:200])
if not dry.feasible: handoff("transfer infeasible", summary=str(dry.summary))
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: tgt1}); check_move(r, "transfer")
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], fl_z]), approach=W(DOWN), jaw_line=W(jaw_new), interaction="precision")},
                    speed="careful")
print("place-descend", r.status, r.ok, r.failure_code, r.target_error_m)
if (not r.ok) and (r.target_error_m or 1) > 0.004: handoff("place-descend failed", failure=r.failure_code, err=r.target_error_m)
r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"}); print("open", r.status, r.measured_opening)
r = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(P([fl_xy[0], fl_xy[1], Z_TRANSFER]), interaction="free_space")}, speed="normal")
check_move(r, "release-lift")
r = tools.return_home(arms=[arm]); print("home", r.status, r.ok)

# ---------- verify from fresh head view
obs3 = current()
ps3 = pieces(obs3)
print("pieces now:", [(np.round(x["center"][:2],4).tolist(), round(x["zmin"],4)) for x in ps3])
near = [x for x in ps3 if float(np.linalg.norm(x["center"][:2]-pad_xy)) < 0.05]
if not near: handoff("placed piece not found", pad=pad_xy.tolist(),
                    seen=[np.round(x["center"][:2],3).tolist() for x in ps3])
q = near[0]
xy_err = float(np.linalg.norm(q["center"][:2]-pad_xy)); ang = float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(q["axis"][0],q["axis"][1])))
print("PLACED", tag, "xy_err_mm", round(1000*xy_err,1), "ang_deg", round(ang,1), "zmin", round(q["zmin"],4), "pad_top", pad_top)
if xy_err > TOL_XY or abs(ang) > TOL_ANG or abs(q["zmin"]-pad_top) > TOL_Z:
    handoff("placement check failed", tag=tag, xy_err_mm=1000*xy_err, ang_deg=ang, zmin=q["zmin"], pad_top=pad_top)
print("OK", tag)
